## Command 2: System Autopilot

## Command 3: Next Fix Report

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

---

Ready to proceed when you share the command outputs.

### What you should do next (in order)

1) **Run AUB module autopilot and auto-select best**

and I can tell you whether the selection behavior and next-fix recommendations look consistent.
